summary: Dispatches a physics state update on operation type a2 (3, 4 or 5). Each type selects a distinct array base stored in this (+0x4C, +0x58 or +0x64), a per-type global data table, and a row stride; it computes an element pointer v7 into a 36-byte-stride local array and a global index v6, writes flt_7D0AD4 + *a6 into a float slot reached through (v7+32), then runs ShortComputation_e770(v7, v6, 1), SwitchBasedFloatProcessing(v7, a3) and PhysicsStateVectorConversion(v7, a6), marks the element active at v7+10, and returns the conversion result. For any other a2 value the element and table inputs pass through as a5.

local_names.a3: float array input for the switch processing pass
local_names.a4: row selector indexing the global tables
local_names.a6: float input for the float write and vector conversion

operations.description: Dispatch on a2: if a2 == 3 take the type-3 path, else if a2 == 4 the type-4 path, else if a2 == 5 the type-5 path; otherwise passthrough with v6 = a5 and v7 = a5.
Type 3: table index v6 = dword_5ECF0C[4656 * a4 + 74 * a5]; element v7 = this[19] (this+0x4C) + 36 * (a5 + 4 * a4).
Type 4: element v7 = this[22] (this+0x58) + 36 * (a5 + 2 * a4); table index picks dword_5ED3F0[4656 * a4] when a5 is nonzero, else dword_5ED3AC[4656 * a4].
Type 5: table index v6 = dword_5ED434[4656 * a4 + 17 * a5]; element v7 = this[25] (this+0x64) + 36 * (a5 + 8 * a4).
For types 3/4/5: write float value flt_7D0AD4 + *a6 into the slot at (*(v7 + 32)) + 28.
Run ShortComputation_e770 on the selected element v7 with global index v6 and constant 1.
Run SwitchBasedFloatProcessing on the selected element v7 with the float array a3.
Run PhysicsStateVectorConversion on the selected element v7 with the float input a6; keep its result as the return value.
